story_overview: Leo spends a pensive day at Harbor View, where Marcus is also present. Later, Leo and Marcus visit Trinity Church and meet with Clara and Fiona for a serious conversation inside.

video_prompts:
Trinity Church: An ornate, red-brick Gothic Revival church building.

Leo stands on a city street in front of Trinity Church, turning his head to watch as a motorcycle drives past from right to left in front of the ornate church and the adjacent building covered in the green scaffolding.

Low angle shot at Trinity Church. Marcus, wearing the blue denim jacket, and Leo walk up the stone steps towards the church entrance. Marcus pushes open the wrought-iron gate and they both walk through it into the church grounds.

the wooden church pew: Long church pew made from dark, polished wood, featuring a high, straight backrest, a flat bench seat, and solid end panels.
Close-up of Clara, wearing the dark patterned shirt, sitting on the wooden church pew next to Leo inside Trinity Church. She smiles gently as she listens to someone off-screen.

Fiona: Woman with short, bright red hair, wearing glasses, a blue jacket, and a patterned scarf.

Over-the-shoulder medium shot from behind Marcus, who, wearing the blue denim jacket, sits on the wooden church pew inside Trinity Church. On an opposite pew, Clara faces him and speaks animatedly. Fiona sits next to Clara, listening intently to the conversation and occasionally nodding.
